shared_elements: schematic figural forms rendered in low relief
repeated simple curved/rounded motifs (rounded head in A, arch-like forms in B)
justification: A depicts a single anthropomorphic figure — a large rounded head with carved eyes and nose above a body with schematic arms and hands folded across the front — while B depicts a register-organised relief field of small animals (bird-like creatures, a snake) beneath a row of three arch/quadruped-like motifs and a zigzag/net band. The only real correspondence is the shared reduction of forms to bold, simplified schematic outlines in relief; there is no shared subject, no shared combination, and no comparable arrangement (one whole-figure sculpture versus a multi-register animal composition).
